patterns.pattern: A test that asserts the shape of its own construction proves nothing about the code under test.
patterns.context: PR #4485 shipped assertions that restated their fixtures and passed regardless of the behavior they named.
patterns.application: Anti-Pattern 7 in TESTING-ANTI-PATTERNS.md and the SHOULD 10 extension in testing.md.

avoidances.antipattern: Documenting a defect on a branch that does not carry the code the prose cites.
avoidances.consequence: The citation resolves in the author worktree and dangles for every reader of the merged branch. No gate in this repository reports it, because orphan-ref-validator matches file paths and markdownlint ignores .agents entirely.
avoidances.correction: Ran git grep for every cited symbol on this branch, found a test name and a constant that lived only on fix/gate-aggregator-did-not-run, and moved that half of the documentation to the branch owning the code.
